notes.title: Visual Upgrade! v1.06
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
City Climber was released on Steam exactly one year ago, so I've decided to upgrade the game's visuals as a little surprise! Game now uses volumetric lighting and bunch of cool postprocessing effects. They can be all turned on/off in the in-game options. I also fixed some bugs and tweaked gameplay mechanics. Don't forget to check out the new trailer and screenshots on the game's store page! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/5a6f098555133fd6d97370b4628e2adf993725f6.png

Changelog:
- Improved visuals
- Fixed UI not being scaled properly
- Improved climbing controls when using mouse / gamepad
- Falling objects are now visibly damaged, so you can tell more easily what is not safe to grab
- Added new settings in in-game options
- Fixed collider in various places, so stuff should be easier to grab.

Have a nice day!  ːclimberbottleː ːclimberpaperː

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
New Features
Fast Restart - Just press 'R' or 'Gamepad X' for immediate restart in story levels. Great for speedrunners who want to improve their leaderboard position.
Cast model - Some people wondered why did your cast disappear after stage 6, Now it can be seen at the beginning of stage 7, as our climber has super healing abilities and he just doesn`t need it anymore! ːsteamhappyː
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/c1a7c5d8530d17b60dfba9042d990be0346f3460.png

Fixes/Adjustments
- fixed typo in main menu
- fixed collision zone of electric cable in story stage 3
- made wind in story stage 8 weaker 
- in story stage 6 you could grab the moving bed through railing
(character usualy exploded as it was squished afterwards)

Make sure to make a post in our Discussion Forum if you find a bug or if you got an awesome idea how to make City Climber a better game!
Thanks! :)

notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
Hey guys!
We are releasing on the next Friday and I would like to talk to you about all the progress that had been made on City Climber since we passed Greenlight.ːsteamhappyː

First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for all the amazing support!
I`m working on City Climber alone, so it really helps to see, that there are people who are looking forward to playing it!

One of the things you might have noticed, Is that I pushed the release date to a later date maybe 2 or 3 times. Let`s say that one thing led to another... and I have quit my university so I could focus on making City Climber as good as possible. Suddenly I had time to improve a lot of things that I was not happy about. So I did ! It took a while but I`m really happy with the results. ːsteamhappyː See for yourself!

Oh.. I almost forgot! You can also enjoy story mode in local co-op (two controllers), where you play as a robot with two differently colored arms. Each player controls only one arm, so you have to comunicate a lot!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/e00f16909f024bafd0b90a49c5738eaa911eb35f.png

Challenges
Challenges are the "more crazy" part of the game. There are currently 10 leves for each mode, always with some funny new twist. They usually take around 1 hour to complete.

Step by Step
Objective: roll to the end of stairs!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/de066ba4d27769de1a6177d95422eaa836167797.png

Leap of Faith
Objective: jump from a crane and hit the target below!

Crazy Carts

Party Mode
Pary Mode is local, turned based competitive multiplayer. You select your characters and each player gets randomly selected set of chalenges he has to complete. Player with the most points wins! :)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/1d446646fb096f2ec776b5efe529e307b9155070.png

See you around! ːsteamhappyː

We are releasing on the next Friday and I would like to talk to you about all the progress that had been made on City Climber since we passed Greenlight.ːsteamhappyː

First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for all the amazing support!
I`m working on City Climber alone, so it really helps to see, that there are people who are looking forward to playing it!

One of the things you might have noticed, Is that I pushed the release date to a later date maybe 2 or 3 times. Let`s say that one thing led to another... and I have quit my university so I could focus on making City Climber as good as possible.
